tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sga ston rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang legs pas mdzad pa'i dag pa dran pa'i 'grel pa bzhugs so/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa
༄༅/ /sga ston rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang legs pas mdzad pa'i dag pa dran pa'i 'grel pa bzhugs so/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sga ston rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang legs pas mdzad pa'i dag pa dran pa'i 'grel pa bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor gyi nang tshan dag pa dran pa la thog mar gtso bo'i sku'i kha dog rnam 'gyur sogs kyi dag pa ni/ rtsa rgyud gnyis pa'i dgu pa las/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po sogs te/ bcom ldan 'das de yang thugs dmigs pa med pa'i snyingaṃ rjeṃ chen po'i sgo nas sems can la rjes su chags pa'i spyaṃn nyer bzhi po rnams niṃ dmaraṃ poṃ'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin laṃ/ byamaṃs paṃ'i thugaṃs laṃs gzhan du mi 'gyur bar mtshon pas sku dang yaṃn laṃg gnaṃg cing / gang la gang 'os kyi zang zing gi sbyin pa byin nas 'khor du bsdus pa'i sems can la/ phar phyin drug po rgyud tshod dang mthun pa'i chos ston la snyan par smra ba dang / de nyid gzhan la nyams su lan du 'jug pa don spyod pa dang / gzhan chos la 'jug pa'i slad du bdag nyid nyams su len pa la brtson pa don mthun pa ste/ bsduṃ baṃ'i dngoṃs poṃ bzhiṃ yisaṃ niṃ sems can 'dul bar mdzad par mtshon pa'i zhabaṃs niṃ rnamaṃ paṃ bzhiṃ zhesaṃ brjoṃd do/ /zhaṃl brgyaṃd ni rnaṃm paṃr thaṃr paṃ brgyaṃd rnam par dag pa ste/ de'ang 'jig rten pa'i rnam thar dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dang / mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar brgyad rnams su yod pa las/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i rnam thar brgyad kyi gzugs can gzugs la blta ba'i rnam thar ni/ nang gzugs yod par 'du shes pas/ yul phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams la bltas nas/ tshul dbyibs kyi sgo nas che chung sna tshogs dang / kha dog gi sgo nas mdzes mi mdzes sna tshogs su sprul bsgyur byed pa'o/ /gzugs med gzugs la blta ba'i rnam thar ni/ nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas/ yul dang tshul sngar bzhin byed pa'o/ /sdug pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ sems bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten nas/

dgos pa gzugs sdug pa sprul 'dod pa dang / mi sdug pa sprul mi 'dod pa byung na sprul pa mi rdzogs pas de'i gnyen por/ tshul sbyor ba'i gnas skabs su sdug mi sdug phan tshun ltos pa'i 'du shes dang / rjes su 'brel ba'i 'du shes dang / dngos gzhi'i dus su sdug par rtse gcig tu 'du shes te 'du shes sum ldan gyi sgo nas bsgom pa'o/ /gzugs med rnam thar bzhi ni/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med pa'i dang / yod min med min gyi skye mched bzhi po gzugs med zhi ba'i ro myong gi sgrib pa las grol ba'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /'gog pa'i rnam thar ni/ 'phags pas zag bcas kyi 'du shes dang / tshor ba 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug la snyoms par zhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam thar brgyad ni/ 'phags lam brgyad de/ 'og tu 'chad do/ /gsum pa mthar thug gi rnam thar brgyad ni dbang phyug brgyad de/ phyag mtshan dag pa'i skabs su 'chad do/ /phyagaṃ bcu drug niṃ stongaṃ paṃ nyiṃd baṃcu drugaṃ rnam par dag pa nyidaṃ do/ /de la mig sogs nang gi skye mched drug rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni nang stong pa nyid/ gzugs sogs yul drug rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni phyi stong pa nyid/ yul dang yul can gnyis ka rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni phyi nang stong pa nyid/ de lta bu'i stong nyid de'ang rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid/ phyogs bcu'i snod bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni chen po stong pa nyid/ don dam pa ni rtogs bya'i mchog de bzhin nyid dang / thob bya'i mchog mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis te/ de gnyis rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni don dam pa stong pa nyid/ skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bcas pas 'dus byas khams gsum po rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid/ skye 'gags med pa nam mkha' sogs 'dus ma byas thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid/

rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba ni mtha' las 'das pa ste/ de rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid/ thog ma dang mtha' ma med pa ni 'khor ba ste/ de rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni thog ma dang mtha' ma med pa stong pa nyid/ byang chub phyogs mthun sogs ni spang bar bya ba'am/ dor bar bya ba min pas dor ba med pa ste/ de rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni dor ba med pa stong pa nyid/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid sus kyang ma byas pas rang bzhin zhes bya ste/ de rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas pa dang / 'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos su gdags pa de thams cad kyi brtags don gzugs su rung ba sogs ni rang gi mtshan nyid yin la/ de rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid/ dus gsum ni mi dmigs pa ste/ de rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid/ rkyen las byung ba'i dngos po rnams la rgyun dang tshogs pa'i dngos po med pa ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid de/ de rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /gugaṃ bskyedaṃ ni man+t+ra ste/ ma la u yi rkyen byin pas mu tra ste/ phyag rgya zhes par 'gyur la/ de ni rgyan te rus rgyan lnga po nyid kyiṃs niṃ sangaṃs rgyaṃs lngaṃ rnam par mtshon te/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa zhes sogs so/ /zhi bas mi thul ba'i gdugaṃ paṃ can rnams 'dulaṃ ba'i phyiraṃ khroṃ boṃ'i cha lugs can nyidaṃ dang / de bzhin du chags can 'dul ba'i phyir yum dang zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can dang / gti mug can 'dul ba'i phyir kha dog dang dbyibs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa can nyid do/

/deṃ nyidaṃ gsumaṃ niṃ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum ste/ de spyanaṃ gsumaṃ poṃs mtshon pa'o/ /shaṃ yi khams rnam par dag pa niṃ lha mo puṃk+kaṃ sīṃ ruṃ bshaṃd cing / deṃ bzhiṃn du khraṃg gi khams dag pa niṃ riṃ khrodaṃ maṃ/ gdoṃl paṃ moṃ niṃ khuṃ baṃ dag par brjoṃd/ g.yuṃng moṃs rkaṃng mar daṃng tshiṃl buṃ dgaṃ par byed do/ /kha zas zos tshad thams cad dwangs snyigs gnyis su gyur nas snyigs ma bshang gcir gyur nas phyir dor/ dwangs ma nang na gnas la/ de zhag gcig nas khrag tu 'gyur/ de zhag gcig nas sha de zhag gcig nas tshil/ de zhag gcig nas rus pa/ de zhag gcig nas rkang / de zhag gcig nas khu bar 'gyur ba la dwangs ma bdun 'gyur du grags/ de lta bu'i dwangs ma bdun po de las 'o ma la spris ma chags pa ltar paṃgs paṃ rim pa bdun grub pa rnam par dag pa ni/ byangaṃ chubaṃ kyi yanaṃ lagaṃ bduṃn te/ byang chub yan lag bdun ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /mgo rus/ rkang rus/ tshigs rus/ rtsibs rus te ruṃs paṃ'i rigs bzhi ni 'phags pa'i bdeṃn paṃ bzhiṃ poṃ rnam par dag pa nyidaṃ do/ /de'ang 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang / rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa ste 'khor ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang / 'bras bu 'gog pa/ rgyu lam gyi bden pa ste myang 'das rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bzhi'o/ /phyag mtshan gyi dag pa ni gur le'u lnga pa las/ glo dang sogs te/ gloṃ ba na ba dngaṃ / dbugaṃs mi bde ba dngaṃ / deṃ bzhiṃn du smyoṃ ba sems 'khrugs pa dang / lus kyi khongaṃ snad pas kha nas khrag skyugs pas lus skaṃm par byed pa dang / mdzeṃ nad dngaṃ / biṃrdziṃ kaṃ ste 'brum bu'i nad dang / mchinaṃ paṃ na ba dang / mtsheṃr paṃ'i naṃd de nad brgyad po de rnamaṃs niṃ g.yas pa'i phyag mtshan glangaṃ poṃ che laṃ sogaṃs pa'i srog chags brgyad du go rimaṃ bzhin du sprul nas bzung bas gdul bya'i nad de dag bdag nyid la blangs nas bde ba chen po'i ye shes su bsgyur ba mtshon par shesaṃ par byaṃ'o/

/g.yon pa'i phyag mtshan saṃ yi lha niṃ daṃng poṃr byas pa nas noṃr 'dziṃn mthaṃ' maṃr byas pa'i bar brgyad kyis ni/ 'gro ba rnams la dbaṃng phyugaṃ brgyaṃd kyi dngos grub niṃ rtsolaṃ baṃr mdzaṃd pa mtshon pa'o/ /de'ang gang la gang 'dul gyis sku mtha' yas pa ston pa sku'i dbang phyug rang rang gi sgra skad dang mthun pa'i gang 'dul chos 'khor rgyun mi 'chad pa bskor ba gsung gi dbang phyug dmigs med thugs rje chen po'i dpal dang ldan cing sems can gyi khams dbang ji lta ba mkhyen pa thugs kyi dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la dbang 'byor ba rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang phyug 'khor 'das dus gsum mnyam nyid ro gcig tu mngon par byang chub pa ni kun 'gro'i dbang phyug snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gis sems can gyi don mngon par bsgrub par 'dod pa 'dod pa'i dbang phyug yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du bskang ba ci 'dod bskyed pa'i dbang phyug mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa yon tan gyi dbang phyug ste brgyad do/ /phyag mtshan brgyad dang sbyar tshul/ sku dang sa gzhan gyi rten byed par mtshungs/ gsung dang chu gzhan 'dzin par mtshungs/ thugs dang me gsal bar mtshungs/ rdzu 'phrul dang rlung g.yo bar mtshungs/ kun 'gro dang zla ba'i 'od zer gzhan thams cad la 'jug par mtshungs/ ci 'dod byed pa dang nyi mas gzhan smin par byed pa mtshungs/ phrin las dang gshin rje mthu dang ldan par mtshungs/ yon tan dang nor 'dzin gzhan gyi dbul ba sel bar mtshungs/ phyag rgya drug gi dag pa ni/ spyiṃ boṃ'i 'khoṃr loṃ ni rigs kyi gtso bo miṃ bskyoṃd paṃ dang / rnaṃ chaṃ'i ngo bo nyid dag pa'i bdaṃg nyiṃd 'oṃd dpaṃg meṃd/ mguṃl gyiṃ phreṃng baṃ riṃn cheṃn rigs kyi bdaṃg po/ lagaṃ paṃ la sogs pa'i gdub bu drug ni rnaṃm paṃr snangaṃ mdzaṃd dngaṃ /

skaṃ ragaṃs laṃ niṃ donaṃ yoṃd grub pa rnam par dag pa'i gnaṃs so/ /yanaṃ lagaṃ kuṃn laṃ zhes pa ni se ral kha'i mchod phyir thogs pa ste de ni rigs drug pa rdoṃr 'dziṃn mgoṃn du blta bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa la/ brten pa lha'i dag pa ni/ bcomaṃ ldanaṃ 'daṃs niṃ chosaṃ kyiṃ dbyingaṃs kyiṃ yeṃ shesaṃ gzugs kyi sku'i rnam par shar ba'o/ /de bzhin du gauṃ rīṃ niṃ meṃ longaṃ ltaṃ bu'iṃ yeṃ shesaṃ/ tsauṃ rīṃ niṃ mnyaṃm paṃ nyidaṃ kyiṃ yeṃ shesaṃ/ baiṃ taṃ liṃ niṃ soṃ soraṃ rtogaṃ pa'iṃ yeṃ shesaṃ/ ghaṃsmaṃ rīṃ niṃ byaṃ baṃ grubaṃ pa'iṃ yeṃ shesaṃ gzugs kyi skur shar ba'o/ /de la chos dbyings ye shes ni/ chos ni sangs rgyas kyi chos/ dbyings ni rgyu ste/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma phra mos kyang dag pa'i ye shes so/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes ni/ ye shes gang la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du snang ba'o/ /mnyam nyid ni/ ye shes gang gis 'khor 'das la sogs pa'i chos kun mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'o/ /so sor rtog pa ni/ ye shes gang rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas shes bya thams cad ma 'dres par mkhyen pa'o/ /bya ba grub pa ni/ gdul bya 'dul ba la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ro gcig tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa'o/ /puṃk+kaṃ siṃ niṃ bde ba dang ldan 'dod kyi byamaṃs paṃ tshadaṃ medaṃ paṃ/ shaṃ baṃ riṃ niṃ sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snyingaṃ rjeṃ tshadaṃ medaṃ paṃ/ gdolaṃ paṃ moṃ niṃ bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral na dga' ba'i dgaṃ' baṃ tshadaṃ meṃd paṃ/ g.yungaṃ moṃ niṃ chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btaṃng snyomaṃs tshaṃd meṃd paṃ lha mo'i gzugs su shar ba'o/ /rten gyi dag pa ni/ gzhaṃl yaṃs khangaṃ niṃ byangaṃ chubaṃ kyiṃ phyogaṃs kyiṃ chosaṃ sumaṃ cuṃ rtsaṃ bduṃn rnamaṃ paraṃ dgaṃ paṃ'o/

/zhes pa ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor ni rang gi sems nyid rnam par dag pa/ de'i yon tan chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid yin pas gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi ste/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /'dod rnam bzhi ni dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ rta babs ka ba dang bcas pa bzhi ni yang dag par spong ba bzhi/ sgo khyud bzhi ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ rtsig pa lnga ni dbang po lnga/ de'i kha dog lnga ni stobs lnga/ gzhal yas khang gi rgyan gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ gos/ 'phan/ me tog gi phreng ba/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang bdun ni byang chub yan lag bdun/ nang gi ka ba brgyad ni 'phags lam brgyad do/ /drwa ba ni nyon mongs pa 'joms pa/ drwa phyed ni nye ba'i nyon mongs pa 'joms pa/ rdo rje'i gdung bzhi ni chos kyi gnas bzhi rjes su dran pa ste/ 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ zag pa dang bcas pa sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba'o/ /zhes pa bzhi'o/ /phyi dang nang gi rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum po ni phyogs thams cad du mnyam pa nyid du rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'o/ /de la byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po dmigs pa/ ngo bo/ grogs/ bsgom tshul/ 'bras bu ste lnga lnga tshang bar mdor bsdus te bshad na/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ni lus tshor sems chos bzhi la/ rjes su blta ba'i shes rab dang / dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i dran pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ kun rdzob kyi dbang du byas na lus mi gtsang ba/ tshor ba sdug bsngal ba/ sems mi rtag pa/ chos bdag med pa'am don dam par thams cad rang bzhin med par bsgom pas/ gnas skabs su phyin ci log spong ba dang / bden pa bzhi la 'jug pa dang / mthar zag bcas kyi lus sogs dang bral bar 'gyur ba'o/

/yang dag spong ba bzhi ni/ mi dge ba dang / dge ba gnyis skyes pa dang ma skyes pa bzhi la dmigs nas/ blang dor byed pa'i rgyu'i brtson 'grus mtshungs ldan dang bcas pas mi dge ba skyes pa spong ba dang ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa dang / dge ba skyes pa spel ba dang / ma skyes pa bskyed pa bzhi la/ 'dun 'bad brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sems 'dzin pa dang / 'jog pa'i tshul gyis bsgoms pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs nyams pa dang / mngon du mi byed pa dang / gnyen po 'phel ba dang thob pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ ting nge 'dzin grub pa'i bya ba sprul bsgyur sogs la gus par sbyor ba'i 'dun pa dang / rgyun du sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus dang / sngon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi bag chags dang ldan pa'i sems pa dang / dmigs pa rnam par 'byed pa'i dpyod pa bzhis/ nyes pa lnga spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pas/ rdzu 'phrul sogs ji 'dod bzhin mngon du 'gyur ba'o/ /dbang po lnga ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la dmigs pa'i dad sogs lnga mtshungs ldan dang bcas pas dad pas bden pa rnams la yid ches pa dang / brtson 'grus kyis bden pa rtogs pa'i phyir du spro ba dang / dran pas dmigs rnam mi brjed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis rtse gcig pa dang / shes rab kyis mi rtag pa la sogs pa rab tu 'byed pa'i tshul gyis bsgoms pas myur du mthong lam skye ba dang / rtogs pa phyi ma 'byung ba'o/ /bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la dbang byed pas na dbang por brjod do/ /stobs lnga ni/ dad brtson dran ting shes rab lnga mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i phyir stobs zhes bya la gzhan dbang po dang 'dra'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po ji lta ba dmigs pa'i dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag sogs bdun mtshungs ldan dang bcas pas sdug bden la dmigs nas des dben pa tshol ba dang /

kun 'byung dang bral bar 'dod pa dang / 'gog pa mngon du byed pa dang / lam gyis nyon mongs pa spangs pas yongs su bsgyur ba la gnas pas/ mthong spang spong bar byed pa'o/ /de la dran pa ni gnas kyi yan lag ste/ dge chos mi nyams par byed pa'i phyir/ chos rab rnam 'byed ni ngo bo nyid kyi ste/ mthong lam byang chub ni shes rab kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ brtson 'grus ni nges par 'byung ba'i ste/ bgrod bya ji srid bar 'gro bar byed pa'i phyir/ dga' ba ni phan yon gyi ste/ sems rgyud tshims par byed pa'i phyir/ lhag ma gsum ni nyon mongs pa med pa'i yan lag ste/ de'ang shin sbyangs ni/ gang gis nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba'i ste/ nyon mongs kyi rgyu gnas ngan len 'jig pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin ni gang du nyon mongs med pa'i ste/ ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ni gnas 'gyur ba'i phyir/ btang snyoms ni kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i ngo bo'i yan lag ste/ bying rgod dang bral bas kun nas nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags lam brgyad ni/ dmigs grogs bsgom tshul sngar dang 'dra la/ ngo bo la yang dag pa'i lta ba ni/ yongs su gcod pa'i yan lag ste/ mnyam bzhag tu rtogs pa'i de kho na nyid nges par 'dzin pa'i phyir/ rtog pa ni/ gzhan la go bar byed pa'i yan lag ste/ ji ltar rtogs pa'i don ston pa'i ngag kun nas slong ba'i phyir/ ngag dang las mtha' 'tsho ba gsum ni/ gzhan yid ches par byed pa'i yan lag ste/ rim bzhin gzhan gyis dris pa'i lan lung ston pas lta ba rnam dag dang / spyod pa phun tshogs kyis tshul khrims rnam dag dang / log 'tsho spangs te de bzhin gshegs pas ji ltar gnang ba bzhin du longs spyod pas 'tsho ba rnam dag tu yid ches par byed pa'i phyir/ rtsol ba ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i yan lag ste/ kun sbyor lhag ma spong ba'i phyir/ dran pa ni nye nyon sbyong ba'i yan lag ste/

zhi gnas kyi mtshan ma ma brjed pa bying rgod sogs kyi go skabs mi 'byed pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin ni yon tan khyad par can la sgrib pa sbyong ba'i yan lag ste/ mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /'bras bu ni sgom spang rnams spong ba dang / yon tan bskyed pa'o/ /duraṃ khrodaṃ brgyadaṃ niṃ rang gi lus 'di nyid kyi snaṃ bugaṃ gnyis gcigaṃ tuṃ bsdomaṃs pa'iṃ lusaṃ kyiṃ buṃ gaṃ brgyad rnamaṃ paraṃ dgaṃ paṃ ste/ bshang lam du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ kha tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ sna bug gnyis 'bar ba'i dur khrod/ mig g.yas 'jigs byed thod pa can/ mig g.yon ki li ki li'i sgra sgrogs pa/ rna ba g.yas drag tu dgod pa/ rna ba g.yon dbang phyug nags tshal/ gsang gnas 'jigs byed mun pa ste/ dur khrod brgyad bu ga so sor dag pa dang sbyar te rje btsun rtse mos gsungs so/ /phung po'i dag pa ni/ gzugs phung sogs te/ rang bcom ldan 'das su gsal ba'i gzugs su rung ba du ma spungs pa'i gzugaṃs phungaṃ ni lha mo rdoṃ rjeṃ maṃ yinaṃ teṃ/ de bzhin du nyams su myong ba tshoraṃ ba'iṃ phung po laṃ niṃ/ gsang ba'i dkaṃr moṃ nyidaṃ do/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'duṃ shesaṃ ni lha mo chuṃ yiṃ rnalaṃ 'byoṃr maṃ'o/ /yul la mngon par 'du byed pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi 'duṃ byedaṃ kyi phung po ni rdoṃ rjeṃ mkha'aṃ 'groṃ maṃ/ yul so sor rnam par rig pa'i rnamaṃ par sheṃs pa'i phuṃng poṃ dag pa'i tshuṃl gyisaṃ niṃ/ bdagaṃ medaṃ rnalaṃ 'byoṃr maṃr ngo bo nyid kyi gnasaṃ soṃ/ /khams kyi dag pa ni/ saṃ niṃ sogs te sra ba pa'i khams dag pa ni lha mo puṃk+kaṃ siṃ zhesaṃ brjodaṃ do/ /de bzhin du gsher ba chuṃ khamaṃs dag pa ni rngonaṃ paṃ maṃ ste ri khrod ma zhesaṃ brjodaṃ/ dro ba meṃ'i khams dag pa niṃ gtumaṃ moṃ ste gdol pa moraṃ shesaṃ paraṃ byaṃ/ g.yo ba rlungaṃ gi khams dag pa niṃ g.yungaṃ moraṃ rabaṃ tuṃ gragaṃs so/
